sahel_precipitation.scientific_name: Monthly precipitation amount derived from PRECTOTCORR
limitations: NASA POWER / MERRA-2 bias-corrected reanalysis, not direct station observations or satellite-only rainfall.
Monthly amounts equal source mean daily rate times actual Gregorian month length; source rounding retained.
Western Sahel subset only: no land mask; not the whole Sahel.
This subset did not show statistically supported opposing trends.
Monthly-amount trend and annual-total grid trends have different aggregation semantics.
